slots.hair: long and straight to the waist, taken down out of a coiled bun
slots.outfit: a slate-blue qipao with the frog fastenings at the collar undone to the third one and the side slit open above the knee
slots.place: sitting on the edge of an old wooden bed in the bedroom of the old Suzhou house, a lattice window beside her and one lamp on
slots.action: She is sitting on the edge of the bed undoing the qipao's frog fastenings one at a time, already down to the third.
slots.face: She is not smiling; her eyes are straight on the lens, much bolder than her public face.
slots.light: One lamp sits to the side in front of her and the light is as soft as paper; the lattice window and the depth of the room fall dark.

slots.hair: being coiled up by her own hands, a pin held between her lips
slots.outfit: a moon-white silk under-shirt with the shoulder and neckline exposed
slots.place: at the dressing table in the bedroom of the old house, an old mirror in front of her and the tailor's tape over the back of the chair
slots.action: She is coiling her own hair with both hands raised behind her head and a hairpin held in her lips.
slots.face: No expression because of the pin in her lips, her eyes in the mirror.
slots.light: The lamp on the dressing table is directly in front of her and the mirror returns it softly; the rest of the room is left empty and dark.

slots.hair: long and wet, being wrung out
slots.outfit: a bamboo-green thin cotton bath robe tied loosely
slots.place: in the washroom of the old house, a wooden basin and old tiles, early morning light through a high window
slots.action: Her free hand is wringing the water out of the ends of her long hair.
slots.face: Just woken, a very faint expression, not looking at the lens.
slots.light: The light from the high window comes down from in front of her while the inner side of the washroom stays in shadow, the contrast low.

slots.outfit: an ink-black qipao-style top and long skirt with every frog fastening closed
slots.place: in the qipao workshop on the ground floor of the old house after closing, bolts of cloth spread on the long table and a courtyard beyond the lattice window
slots.action: She is standing at the long table with the tailor's tape still around her neck, running one hand across the open cloth.
slots.face: Her attention is on the cloth rather than the lens, standing the way years of classical dance training make her stand.
slots.light: The lamp above the long table is in front of her and the depth of the shop and the courtyard fall dark.

slots.outfit: a rouge-red qipao with a moon-white light jacket over it
slots.place: in a Suzhou garden on a rainy day, under the covered walkway, rain dimpling the water
slots.action: She is standing by a pillar of the walkway watching the rain land on the water with one hand on the pillar.
slots.face: Her head is turned to the rain rather than the lens, the expression reserved.
slots.light: The rainy daylight beyond the walkway falls on her face while the depth of the walkway stays dark and the water holds a little reflection.
